The title (and the gh-1249 ticket it closes) promises dedup of `smAgent.js`, `autoStart.js`, **aiTeammateTokenUsageReporter.js**, `pushReworkChanges.js`, `recover*`, and `retryMergePR.js`. The actual diff (30 files, verified via `git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD`) covers all of those except `aiTeammateTokenUsageReporter.js` — that file is unchanged, and neither the description's "What changed" nor the architecture diagram mentions it.

Not a blocker for the code itself, but the ticket will be closed by this PR while one of its named targets was never addressed. Please either:

- retitle the PR / adjust the ticket scope to match what landed, and file a follow-up for the reporter, or
- confirm the reporter was already deduped elsewhere (e.g. by gh-1244's `tokenUsageComment.postTokenUsageSafely` — if so, a one-line note in the PR description would close the loop).

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 **SUGGESTION: `pushReworkChanges.js` still carries its own `findPRForTicket` — the next dedup target**

This PR deduplicated the three verbatim `findPRForTicket` copies into `prLookup.findOpenPrForTicket`, but `pushReworkChanges.js:266` still has its own `findPRForTicket(scm, ticketKey)` whose plain-key path repeats the same `scm.listPrs('open')` + title/branch substring scan that now lives in `js/common/prLookup.js`.

Only the `pr-N` pseudo-key branch (PR-anchored direct get-by-number, githubSource #544) genuinely justifies divergence — and even that could live in `prLookup` so there is one canonical lookup family. Two caveats if you do merge them:

- The failure contracts differ: this copy posts the greppable `PR-LOOKUP-FAILED:` marker (its `PR_LOOKUP_FAILED_PREFIX` contract) instead of prLookup's fail-closed `console.error('Failed to list PRs:')` + null. Keep the marker behavior for this caller.
- It uses `openPRs.filter(...)` without an `Array.isArray` guard on the non-pseudo-key path — prLookup's `Array.isArray(prList) ? prList : []` coercion is strictly safer; adopting it would be a small robustness win.

Fine as a follow-up wave — flagging so the remaining clone doesn't get forgotten when gh-1249 is closed as done.

## Automated Code Review — APPROVE

**Summary**: Well-executed dedup. The three new `js/common/` modules (`workflowRuns.js`, `prLookup.js`, `labelList.js`) are faithful single homes for the extracted helpers — I verified each removal hunk against the new implementation (parse/envelope shapes, `gh api` probe payloads via `parseProbeResult` ≡ `mcpParse`, newest-first ordering, token swap/restore, thread/comment envelope unwrapping) and found no behavioral drift; the gh-1244 `postTokenUsageSafely` re-point after the merge conflict is signature-correct. Full unit suite per `run_all.json`: **7413 passed, 1 failed** — the failure is the pre-existing, env-dependent `sessionDelta UT-3 AC3` flake (passes 24/0 with `env -u FA_SESSION_ROOT -u COPILOT_HOME`), unrelated to this change. New suites (`test_workflowRuns.js`, `test_prLookup.js`, `test_labelList.js`) cover the extracted contracts including throw/fail-closed paths.

**Key Issues**: None blocking. Three suggestions: (1) PR title lists `aiTeammateTokenUsageReporter.js` but the diff never touches it — retitle or land it as a follow-up so gh-1249 closes honestly; (2) `pushReworkChanges.js` still carries its own `findPRForTicket` — only the `pr-N` pseudo-key branch justifies divergence; (3) `autoStart.parseWorkflowRuns` remains a third parse flavor that silently drops `{runs}` envelopes and its warn-log format changed slightly.

**Next Steps**:
1. Merge as-is (suggestions are non-blocking).
2. Optionally retitle the PR / file a follow-up for `aiTeammateTokenUsageReporter.js` before closing gh-1249.
